title: We Were Created for Akhirah
body:
Dunya daniyya, “unworthy world.” Therefore, sensible ones ruled it as well as miserable ones. Bashar alAssad’s tribe is forcing him so that his family may rule Syria and keep the power in their hands. If he does not
die today, tomorrow; if not this month, next month; if not this year, he will die next year because man is not
created for dunya. Man is created for akhirah, but he is leaving that and working for the other world, this
dunya. This is how little mind we have! We are not created for a life that is bound to end, but rather we are
created for Eternal Life. But we neglect it, we forget it.
Here so many fights and battles are for thus cursed dunya. Tawbah yaa Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee! O our
Lord, forgive us. The birth is here, the mirth (joy) of it is in the Hereafter. With the joy of dunya, men forget
the mirth of the Hereafter.
They changed the Torah a lot. Did they leave anything that is not changed? Because our Prophet (s) was
mentioned in it, his coming was announced with his name. But the Jews also went after the life of dunya. To
command dunya. All their enmity and efforts, their whole aim was to command whole world, to be number
one. It was not written like this in Holy Torah. All four holy books call to the servanthood of Allah, not dunya!
The command is, “Be servants to Allah!”

Mankind is following Shaytan and keeping the way Shaytan shows, not the way of prophets. None of the
prophets called people to dunya; they all called to Allah Almighty, “Come, and we may go to Allah!” They are
not listening to this. Shaytan calls, "Come, we may enjoy and have fun in dunya." A great many people go
after it and therefore, it has been declared in every holy book since Prophet Adam (a).
Prophet Adam (a) said to Allah Almighty, "The Prophet of Last Time, the Beloved, will come from my
offspring, so forgive me for the honor of Your Beloved.” Then he was forgiven. Do they not know this? All of
them know! But in this garbage dump called dunya, people keep trying to collect more rubbish! He had
collected, in... who was the king before `Abdullah? He died and only four people performed his janazah
(funeral) prayer, four people took his coffin. No one walked behind his coffin as it was forbidden, and they
took him to.. I don't know if they buried him to Janaat al-Baqi` (in Madinah)?
(Hajjah Roqiya: They buried him at their family cemetery in Riyadh.)
Mawlana Shaykh: Yes, they took him to Riyadh. No one knew when the king came to Riyadh or when he
would be buried. They took him to an unknown place. There was a graveyard there too, and he was buried
somewhere in there. Four people went to the funeral; four people and the man who organized it buried him.
They made the surface of the grave level and did not put a stone at the head nor a sign by the feet of the grave.
Why? They lost his grave; no one knows where he is buried. He is in that cemetery but not one knows where
he is, because if they knew, the evil people will take out his dead body (for ransom) and say, "Give me this
many millions and I will give you his body!” For this reason the grave is level with no markings.
What happened? He left his palaces and is buried in his grave in an unknown place, without a sign for his
grave. These are the people who have quadrillions, these kings. What happened in the end? Nothing. He died,
he was buried and gone. Finished.
But the angels come down for him and say, “Come here! What work have you done?” Angels ask at that time.
His work is finished in dunya. They also leveled his grave with their feet! After burying him, they either read
Fatihah, but because they don't believe, they did not read Ikhlaas or anything else. "Quickly you hold from
this side, you from that side, and you from this side." Each car from one side, took them to the grave. We
don't know if they covered those men's eyes when they were burying him, or if they were from their own men,
they didn't touch the body. I think they were from their own people. They looked and saw that it is all leveled

so they left, moved on, what can you do?
Our Prophet, the Master of the Universe (s), called people to Allah. Shaytan called to dunya, not the Prophet
(s). They may do that and they may suffer. What is all the fighting for, this trashy dunya.
"It will be mine".
"No, it will be mine."
"I will be the head."
"No, I will be the head."
"We will go with what I say."
"No, we go with what I say, not your way!"
People have become foolish. Shaytan made Mankind crazy. They call it's evil 'a curse'. May Allah protect us
from it's evil. All holy books know it. Our people know it but they are escaping from the truth. There is no
Muslim left in dunya who can give it's due right, other than Allah's chosen servants. (Video cuts)
Tawbah yaa Rabbee. Huuu! May we never lose hope in Allah! We have believed. O our Lord, protect us from
the fitna of dunya, protect us, protect us so that we may not fall into this fitna! Amaan yaa Rabbee!
Fatihah.
Because you (a guest) mentioned Bashar al-Assad, President of Syria (who is thinking), “May the whole world
be ours.” Okay then, take it with you; it may be yours!
May Allah protect us from the evil of Shaytan and dunya. May our end be in a good way. We may say, “Allah”
and leave. Yaa Rabbee!
